Handles normal windows (`[start, end)`), midnight-crossing windows (`end <= start` → `[start, 24:00)` on the start day + `[00:00, end)` on the following day, which belongs to the day whose start-day bit was set), `daysMask` day-of-week gating (bit 0 = Monday…bit 6 = Sunday), inclusive start / exclusive end boundaries, disabled-schedule skip, and DST handled implicitly by comparing wall-clock minute-of-day. Zero `android.*` imports at the tested layer.
- Created `app/src/test/java/com/piercingxx/nopemode/core/ScheduleEvaluatorTest.kt` — 11 JUnit tests covering: normal window, midnight-crossing default (1200→480), exact boundary minutes 20:00:00 (inclusive) and 08:00:00 (exclusive), day-mask boundaries across the wrap (Monday→Tuesday, Sunday→Monday), DST spring-forward (2026-03-08) and fall-back (2026-11-01) inside a window, disabled schedule, empty list, and multiple-schedule OR semantics.
